applied_after: target_A H1-H4 collection and target_B_H1 physical capture, before scientific outcome inspection
reason: The preregistration defines two ordered reserve seeds per target, but the worker stored a copy of that list in every block. The recovery path could therefore have reused one reserve across sibling blocks, violating canonical-history independence.
uniform_rule: At reserve allocation time, subtract every reserve currently consumed by any sibling block of the same target, then take the first remaining seed in preregistered order. If none remains, mark PROTOCOL_NOT_ROBUST and stop.
